name: Omamagoto ~Himitsu no Oyuugi, Mama ni wa Naisho~
original_name: お保母ごと ～ひみつのおゆうぎ、ママにはないしょ～
source:
Main character loves to play with Momoko Sensei and Mayumi Sensei. He sneaks with them to quiet corners to have some quality time together. If he is lucky, he can even witness some cosplay.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公喜欢和桃子老师、麻由美老师玩耍。他会偷偷和她们躲到安静的角落，共度亲密时光。若运气好，还能看到一些角色扮演。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
